pick.name: HTML screenshot templates rendered by Playwright (Claude Code)
pick.what: Claude Code builds a frames/captions template in HTML and Playwright exports PNGs at exact store sizes
pick.why: Free, no watermark, versioned in the repo, regenerates for every release and locale; fastlane frameit is macOS-only.
pick.free_limits: Free; Play: 2-8 screenshots per device type, 320-3840 px, 9:16 recommended, feature graphic 1024x500. Apple: up to 10 per size, iPhone 6.9" 1206x2622 or 1179x2556

alts.name: AppScreens
alts.what: Web screenshot designer with device frames and localisation
alts.why: Fastest no-code route; free tier includes all devices/templates.

alts.name: Previewed
alts.why: Best-looking 3D mockups for marketing; commercial licence from $9.99 one-time.
alts.free_limits: Lite free: 720p, CC attribution, no commercial licence; Plus $9.99 one-time (commercial)

decision: Code-rendered screenshots are free and repeatable, which matters when every release and language needs new ones. Use Previewed Plus ($9.99) for a hero 3D mockup on the landing page.

verify.note: Shallow check only: free/commercial terms are consistent with the cited licence; not re-opened in this pass.
